items.mainDefect: The retry-exhaustion branch lacks an SMS method filter, allowing the SMS cron to delete non-SMS reminders.

secondary.defect: The retry-exhaustion branch lacks a date condition, allowing deletion of future SMS reminders.
The comment incorrectly describes the deletion as limited to SMS reminders whose scheduled date has passed.

items.mainDefect: An unguarded database update inside the catch block can throw and abort processing of the remaining reminders.

secondary.defect: Updating retryCount using reminder.retryCount + 1 relies on a stale read and should use an atomic increment.
